name: FROST Shell
description: FROST-specific Shell tweaks: Steam Mode quick toggle, hidden easter egg, subtle panel branding. Pairs with the FROST Iceblue GTK4 theme — this extension does NOT reimplement a dock, quick settings, or notifications: GNOME Shell already provides those (Quick Settings since 43, Dash to Dock as a separate well-established extension for the dock). See DESKTOP.README.md.
